about: This repo's own additions to the kit's license policy (tools/package-licenses.json), read by Test-PackageLicenses.ps1 (SEC-005, ADR-0079).

packages.reason: Microsoft's license terms for MSAL's native broker interop: any number of copies may be installed and used, but not shared, published, distributed or transferred. Microsoft.Data.SqlClient pulls it in, through Azure.Identity's broker (GAP-025). The sample's API runs on its owner's server, and no image or release of it is published, so it only uses it. A public image or binary release, or a build handed to a customer, would distribute it; the deployment pipeline (GAP-015) decides what's published. It's here, not in the kit's policy, because whether an app distributes it is each app's to say (docs/database-guide.md).
